_comment: Gemini -- authored in this repo's author's own prior
project (also owned by the author). Cropped and re-assembled from that
project's own spritesheet into this project's per-clip strip format;
no rendering code changed. See docs/ASSETS.md for provenance.
idle/walk repeat their 2 real frames (A,B,A,B) to meet the 4-frame
minimum; attack/special phases borrow adjacent single-frame poses
(punch/kick/charge) duplicated to meet each phase's minimum.
scale is 1, not the 3 the Martial Hero packs use. That 3 was derived for
a pack whose character fills roughly 80 of its 200 source pixels; these
frames are cropped tight and the character fills 171 of 208. Carried over
unchanged it drew a 513px fighter into a 400px arena -- the two fighters
overlapped and both ran off the top of the canvas. Re-derive this per pack
from the character's own pixel height, never by copying another pack's.
